summary.text: Rob Summerfield is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 68 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Elisha King.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business owner.

paragraphs.text: Rob Summerfield was born in Eau Claire, Wisconsin, and lives in Bloomer, Wisconsin.
He graduated from Bloomer High School in 1998 and earned a B.S. in business administration from the University of Wisconsin-Stout in 2002.
His career experience includes working as a small business owner and supper club manager, and he is a member of the Bloomer Chamber of Commerce and the Tavern League of Wisconsin, among other groups.
Summerfield's Ballotpedia profile gives his Assembly tenure as beginning in 2017.

His 2025-2026 committee assignments are listed as Assembly Organization, Energy and Utilities (vice-chair), Health, Housing and Real Estate, Rules, State Affairs, Tourism, and Veterans and Military Affairs.
